column1: # The fields of the answer of GET /v1/status (P/01.3 N2). The norm refers to this table and does not repeat it in prose; the JSON schema Status
# of the contract (spec/01-store.api.openapi.yaml) carries the same fields.
# A row is a field of the answer object. required_when — the field MUST be present when the expression is true; allowed_when — the field MAY be present
# only when the expression is true, otherwise it is absent. type — the JSON form of the value; value_rule — what the value is, by the mode and the role.
# required_when and allowed_when are CEL. Variables:
#var mode string — box (the store of a box, one voter without raft), group (a voter of a raft group, a group of one included), door (a door without a vote)
#var raft string — the Raft state of the instance (not the field role of the answer): leader, follower, candidate, shutdown; a box is leader; a door has none, ""
#var ahead double — by how many seconds the admission time of the last record is ahead of the clock of this instance
#var lim map<string,int> — the parameters of the lesson, only the names of #lim
#lim CLOCK_SKEW — P/01.1 N0 «Cluster clocks»; the value — forms/runtime-constants.tsv
# MemberId — a member identifier of P/01.3 N2 (1–128 ASCII characters: the first a letter/digit, then letters/digits/_/./-). uint64 — a JSON integer 0 … 2^64 − 1, exact.

column5: box: Leader; door: Door; group: the Raft state of the voter
the -api address of the leader, as in members; empty if the leader is unknown or was started without -api; box: its own -api address, empty without -api
the id of the leader; empty if the leader is unknown; box: its own id
the ids of the voters; box: [<id>]
id → the -api address; a member without -api is not in the map, the map can be {}; a value is never empty; box: {<id>: <api>}, without -api {}
this instance's effective row-weight ceiling in bytes, the value of -max-value (the row weight of P/01.1), separately from -max-body; the acceptance stand parameters are P/01.3 N5

this instance's actual configured -max-body in entity-body bytes (including JSON whitespace and an actual LF, excluding HTTP framing); its default is owned only by forms/daemon-flags.tsv; not derived from max_value; the installer reads it for the static finite-profile check before writes; a local observation, not a confirmation by the majority
by how many seconds the admission time of the last record is ahead of the clock; a follower and a door without a vote have no field
